rationale: Rename the existing Elevate Renewables record to its current public brand, Elevate Infrastructure, while preserving the former brand and legal platform identity as aliases rather than creating a duplicate company. Supersede the census's ADD_OWNER recommendation because the existing ArcLight Capital Partners ownership period already represents the census manager, ArcLight Capital. Correct the owner stake to 100% based on ArcLight's explicit wholly-owned disclosure, retain ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII as the ownership vehicle, and retain the 2022 formation and investment year because ArcLight's primary formation announcement says it formed the platform in 2022. ArcLight's current portfolio modal displays 2021 but also contains placeholder copy and a malformed website URL, so that isolated metadata is not used. Add the current website and Boston headquarters, correct the Arthur Kill announcement date, refresh direct ownership and identity evidence, and retain closed-active status because current 2026 sources continue to identify Elevate as ArcLight-backed and no Elevate-specific sale or pending exit was found through August 13, 2026. This second attempt preserves the database's canonical label and type for each reused shared Source; the first attempt was rejected during the protected dry run and made no database write.

beforeImage.name: Elevate Renewables
beforeImage.description: Elevate Renewables develops and owns battery energy storage projects in the United States. The platform serves wholesale power markets and grid reliability needs through an asset-heavy development model focused on interconnection, site control, permitting, and long-duration storage operation. ArcLight stated in early 2023 that it had committed $150 million to Elevate and that the initial brownfield pipeline exceeded 5 GW across more than 20 sites. The company's strategy emphasizes storage development at or near existing power infrastructure rather than stand-alone greenfield land banking alone. ArcLight announced the capital commitment to Elevate in January 2023, while public sources do not disclose the platform's ownership percentages.

afterImage.name: Elevate Infrastructure
afterImage.description: Elevate Infrastructure, formerly Elevate Renewables, develops, owns and operates utility-scale battery storage and related grid infrastructure in the United States. ArcLight formed the platform in 2022, and ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII remains its 100% owner. The Boston-based company develops projects through co-location, greenfield development and acquisitions; it reports 630 MWh operating in 2026 and more than 12 GWh in development across nine states. No Elevate-specific sale or pending exit was identified through August 13, 2026.
